title: Prophet Nuh and the Great Flood

bridge.when: Many generations after Idris (about 5,000 years ago by one reckoning)
bridge.where: The land of Nuh's people, often placed in Mesopotamia
text: The statues of the last chapter have become idols, and people now worship them. God sends Nuh, known as Noah in the Bible, to call them back.
He calls them for centuries, and only a few listen. This is the story of the ark and the great flood. Every person alive afterwards descends from those who were saved with him.
